name: Sovcombank
verdict: Main shareholders are the founding Khotimsky brothers; the bank has been listed on MOEX since December 2023. Nothing found.
note: FC Rostov premium sponsor per the club's sponsors page (2026-10-03); also official bank of HC Severstal. Rating note: private bank, listed since December 2023; the Khotimsky brothers did not sell into the IPO so their combined stake remains the largest (Reuters via The Moscow Times, Dec 2023); no state in the chain and no human-rights finding against the bank found (searched 3 Oct 2026).
